mapper.select: SELECT cd.id AS course_destination_id, cd.destination_id AS destination_id, cd.visit_order AS visit_order, COALESCE(dt.name, '이름 없는 여행지') AS destination_name, dt.short_description AS short_description, cc.id AS region_id, cc.region_name AS region_name, course.country_id AS country_id, country.region_name AS country_name, COALESCE( ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS image_url FROM course_destinations cd JOIN courses course ON course.id = cd.course_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = cd.destination_id LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' JOIN country_categories cc ON cc.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = course.country_id WHERE cd.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cd.visit_order ASC, cd.id ASC
